verdict.rationale: HeyGen's own docs show natural-language operation. Its Video Agent creates videos from text prompts, iterates through follow-up messages, and revises only the scenes you name. Prompts also work from Slack and from MCP-connected agents such as Claude and Cursor, and a docs assistant maps a plain description of the work to the matching endpoints. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably, and evidence that natural-language control reaches beyond video generation and editing to account, workspace or admin operations.
